During the [[war against Zakuul]], '''a [[Human/Legends|human]] [[Gender/Legends|woman]]''' served as an [[Officer/Legends|officer]] in the [[Eternal Empire]]'s [[Eternal Empire military|military]]. She was among the survivors of the Eternal Empire forces who were brought to [[Iokath]] unwillingly by [[SCORPIO]].<ref name="Chapter 5" />
